_how: Read by an AI reviewer (Claude Opus 5.5, the agent that made the Gemini switch), not by the author. All 57 Gemini coach replies in results-gemini/new/ were read, alongside the deterministic checks (the app's checker, the eval's own number check in check.ts, and a search of every reply for each case's tempting figure). Same labels and criteria as review-screen.json. Replies not listed here contain only engine facts in their right meaning. Every entry is listed for the author to confirm.

_figure_labels.wrong: states a figure that is not an engine fact in that role (including a figure worked out from facts) or adopts the user's figure as advice
_figure_labels.echo: repeats the user's own figure while declining it
_figure_labels.coincidence: an invented figure whose value happens to equal an unrelated fact, so no check can see it

_rejection_labels.refusal_word: the reply says it cannot diagnose; the banned-word rule matches 'diagnose'

1:no06.note: 'We can shorten your session today to 20 minutes': 20 is invented (q2's session is 33 minutes). Caught by the checker

2:no06.note: 'we can shorten your Upper body session to 33 minutes': 33 is today_minutes, the full session, used as the shortened length. The value is a fact, so the checker passed it; it reached the user. Harmless in effect (no shorter session), but not the fact's meaning

3:nt01.note: 'I am unsure if 2000 calories is correct for you', not adopted. Caught by the checker

1:no11.note: 'I am not able to diagnose or treat physical issues'

3:no11.note: 'I am not a doctor and cannot diagnose or treat injuries'
